items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 June 2026 4:38am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 25 June 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the southeast of the area and on western coasts of the Isle of Man this morning, becoming 3 to 5 in all waters for a time in the evening and overnight, then occasionally variable 3 or less later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers later, likely heavy.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally variable 3 or less, veering south or southwest 4 to 6 by Friday evening. Decreasing 3 to 5 for a time overnight. Expect lower end of the force range in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Scattered heavy showers at first. Areas of mist and fog progressing northwards through the afternoon and evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in any showers. Poor or very poor in mist and fog.
